comments.why: Documentary on Ankrom's freeway exit sign fix that stayed for years.
comments.text: Guerilla Public Service. If you've not heard of Richard Ankrom who fixed an exit sign on the 110 freeway, check it out. He made a documentary about it (and there are countless other videos on YouTube covering the story). [VIDEO] He did it so well, the modification stayed in place for years. If you can do it right, I say go for it.
